```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)

# Create the data frame
data <- data.frame(
  Severity_Score = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6),
  Frequency = c(2699, 425, 434, 705, 843, 701, 529),
  Confident_Frequency = c(2289, 94, 72, 154, 187, 103, 232),
  `Confident_%_of_Total` = c(84.8, 22.1, 16.6, 21.8, 22.1, 14.7, 43.9)
)

# Calculate the Unconfident Frequency
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Unconfident_Frequency = Frequency - Confident_Frequency) %>%
  select(Severity_Score, Confident_Frequency, Unconfident_Frequency)

# Convert data to long format
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Confident_Frequency, Unconfident_Frequency),
               names_to = "Confidence",
               values_to = "Count")

# Ensure Confident Frequency is plotted first (at the bottom)
data_long$Type <- factor(data_long$Type, levels = c("Confident_Frequency", "Unconfident_Frequency"))

# Create the stacked bar plot
plot <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = factor(Severity_Score), y = Count, fill = Confidence)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "red"),
                    labels = c("All scorers agreed", "At least 1 scorer disagreed"),
                    name = "Confidence") +
  labs(x = "Severity Score", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), text = element_text(size = 30))


path <- here("analyses", "03_inter_rater_agreement", "stackedbar.png")
png(path, width=1400, height=1000)
print(plot)
dev.off()
```
